optimizedDescription.value: ListSpecs enumerates workspaces via ListWorkspaces; titles from repo.list(); optional summary via index self-heal, never stale optimized.

optimizedContext.value:
# List Specs

## Rules
- `ListSpecs.execute(options?)` gets `ProjectWorkspace` via `ListWorkspaces`; call `SpecRepository.list(options)` per workspace `specRepo`.
- Forward same `ListOptions` + `includeSummary` to every repo. MUST NOT forward metadata-status flag. MUST NOT apply own default `limit`. MUST NOT re-sort/re-filter/re-paginate after repo returns.
- Merged result: workspace declaration order from `ListWorkspaces`, each workspace in repo canonical path order. Cross-workspace pagination out of scope v1.
- Workspace filter: match names against orchestrated list before `list()`.
- Every `SpecListEntry` MUST include `title` from `SpecRepository.list()`; no extra metadata/file reads.
- `includeSummary: true`: resolve `summary` from repo.list() result. Projection at index materialization (`FsSpecIndexCache`) self-heals metadata `policy: 'if-needed'`; if `llmOptimizedContext` active and `optimizedDescription` fresh, use optimized else normalized `description`. Stale/missing optimized MUST fall back to `description`. Missing projection → omit that spec's `summary`, do not fail listing. `ListSpecs` MUST NOT call `GetSpecMetadata` or `MaterializeSpecMetadata` directly.
- `includeSummary` false/omitted: no `summary` on entries; no summary materialization.
- Per-spec summary errors at repo/index: omit `summary`; MUST NOT abort listing. MUST NOT propagate optional-field I/O errors when merging.
- Entry: required `workspace`, `path`, `title`. Optional `summary` only when requested AND materialized. MUST NOT include `metadataStatus`.
- Config factory via `resolveListSpecsDeps` (`listWorkspaces` only). MUST NOT resolve `getMetadata`, `materializeMetadata`, `hasher`, `yaml`.

## Constraints
- MUST NOT modify repositories
- Depend on ListWorkspaces for traversal
- MUST NOT re-resolve title w/ extra I/O
- summary never a stale optimized value
- MUST NOT project or filter by metadata freshness status
